decisions.reason: A minimum quantity lubrication system fits the firm's coolant and lubrication core business and the shift to dry machining, so with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, management has little reason to start problemistic search and will keep it.

A hydrocyclone coolant filter is a standard part of a coolant filtration portfolio and shares components and customers with the firm's established products, so it costs little to carry and is likely kept.
Gravity band filters are a staple, low-risk product in machine tool coolant filtration and complement the established line, so management would keep it absent a clear performance shortfall.
